blocks.text: Agent version 1.12.2 is the minimum-supported version for the anti-tamper protection feature.
Anti-tamper protection for Microsegmentation protects agent functionality from malicious activity. You can enable it via the agent or agent group.

blocks.heading: Enabling Anti-Tamper Protection for Microsegmentation for an Agent Group

blocks.text: Use this preferred method for managing anti-tamper protection.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Cloud > Microsegmentation > Agent Groups.
Edit an existing agent group and change the following options:
In the Tamper Protection section, click Enabled.

blocks.heading: Enabling Anti-Tamper Protection for Microsegmentation for an Agent

blocks.text: Use this method for phased rollout, exceptions, or targeted enforcement.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Cloud > Microsegmentation > Agents.
Edit an existing agent and change the following options:
In the Tamper Protection section, click Inherit From Group (Enabled).
